privacy.title: PRIVACY POLICY
bulletPoints: Your input messages are sent to xAI (Grok API) for AI response generation
Messages are also processed on Vercel infrastructure for application hosting
xAI and Vercel may track your IP address for statistical purposes, but this data is not linked to your conversations
No conversation data is permanently stored or logged by this application
Data transmission occurs only for real-time response generation
No personal information is collected beyond the messages you choose to send
privacy.securityIntro: DO NOT share sensitive information such as:
securityPoints: Passwords, API keys, or access tokens
thirdPartyPoints: xAI: Processes your messages through their Grok-3-Mini model
Vercel: Hosts the application and handles API routing
privacy.retention: Your messages are processed in real-time and are not retained after the session ends.
privacy.questions: For questions about data handling, please refer to:
privacy.dataResponse: Conversations are temporary and not saved on servers. Just press /clear or close the page to delete the conversation - no data is ever stored on servers.
